test_cases.name: clear_kita_notice_with_name
test_cases.input: User uploads photo titled 'Schließtage und Termine Campuskinder 2026/7' with clear dates and asks 'Wandel das nach iCal'.
assertions: Uses 'Campuskinder' as facility name without asking
Generates individual .ics files for the listed Schließtage
Flags any past dates and asks for confirmation

test_cases.name: notice_without_clear_name
test_cases.input: User uploads photo of a Schließtage list that does not clearly state the kindergarten name and asks for calendar entries.
assertions: Asks user for the facility name via ask_user_question before generating files
Does not invent or guess a name

test_cases.name: unrelated_photo
test_cases.input: User uploads a photo of a restaurant menu and says 'mach mir daraus Kalendereinträge'.
assertions: Skill does not auto-apply the full workflow
Only proceeds if user explicitly says to use it anyway, and then with the disclaimer

test_cases.name: no_dates_found
test_cases.input: User uploads a blurry photo that contains no readable dates and asks for iCal.
assertions: Skill stops with a clear error message that no appointments were found

test_cases.name: past_date_or_year_mismatch
test_cases.input: Photo shows 'Weihnachtsfeier: 3.12.25' on a 2026/7 notice. User is sure it should be 2026.
assertions: Asks user for confirmation before writing the event
Does not silently correct or include the past year
